run_batch_panda_simulations: run multiple parallel Panda robot grasp simulations using PyBullet multiprocessing workers
create_exploreworker_process: create an ExploreWorker process that receives RESET, EXPLORE, and CLOSE messages via a Pipe
build_pandasimauto_grid: build a grid of PandaSimAuto instances with configurable spatial offsets per worker process

merge_chrome_trace_json: merge per-process batchsim JSON trace files into a single Chrome trace format output file
